title: Oda-chan to Akechi-kun
titleNative: 織田ちゃんと明智くん
synopsis: I should not be falling in love with this person... Enemy or lovers? The fiercest rivals in history return! Ryunosuke Akechi is the school's toughest delinquent, while Maria Oda is the beautiful idol of the school. Two people who live in different worlds, they start going out after Akechi confesses his feelings. However, when they kiss for the first time, memories of the fiery betrayal at Honnouji fill their heads...! A turbulent high school life begins, as their present-day love affair becomes intertwined with grudges from the past! (Source: Morning, translated)

title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

title: A Certain Magical Index
titleNative: とある魔術の禁書目録
synonyms: To Aru Majutsu no Kinsho Mokuroku
อินเด็กซ์ คัมภีร์คาถาต้องห้าม
synopsis: The story is set in a world where supernatural powers exist through science, and magic exists through religion. In the story, Touma Kamijou is an ordinary high school boy with terrible academic scores and a power called Imagine Breaker. Imagine Breaker can defeat any other power, but it also undermines Kamijou's own good luck. His Imagine Breaker's immense strength is literally immeasurable, so hapless Kamijou is listed at the supernatural level of 0. He happens to meet a girl in white hanging off his window balcony. The girl says she is being chased by sorcerers, and Kamijou learns that the girl is a Church of England nun whose memories have been forcibly replaced by Index-Librorum-Prohibitorum — the 103,000 forbidden texts of the Church.

synopsis: What if modern alcoholic beverages were introduced into a world where brewing technology was still at a medieval European level? One day, Japan found itself able to travel to and from another world. Keen to gain access to the vast lands and resources of this other world, the government devised a plan to subjugate its people not through ‘military force’, but through modern ‘alcohol’. Caught up in this scheme is Touji, a hopeless university student and an unrivalled lover of alcohol. Will he be able to thwart the government’s plans using his overwhelming knowledge and skills regarding alcohol?!
